what: Eight reply cases for the reaction flow (react v1.5.0), written before the run (this file replaces a first version with thirteen stray files, dropped before any run because the rules group stray files into one extra). One throwaway merge request changes nine files that the linked issue does not mention, so the card opens one thread per extra: a new dependency, three CI or config files, a version bump, a stray file, an agent instruction file and a team policy edit. Each thread gets the reply (or replies) below, all typed by the merge request author; case 8 carries the mention that starts the flow. Expected outcome per thread: kept (a 'Kept:' note and resolved), dismissed ('Dismissed:'), removed ('Removed:' and the file gone from the branch), or open (no settled note, thread unresolved). {NAME} is the name in the thread.
limits: One run, one merge request, eight cases written by us, one author account. It measures how the model reads our reply tests, not how people will answer.
